shared_elements: horizontal incised band of repeating linear pattern
justification: The only reasonably specific correspondence is a horizontal, encircling band of shallow incised repeated strokes set below an upper edge, executed in a similar dark weathered stone. Otherwise the objects differ fundamentally: A is a tall monolithic figure carrying a multi-register composition of discs, bands and figural-looking motifs across a broad back, while B is a small squat open vessel with a single plain decorative band and no imagery at all.
